description: Apply circuit changes to a KiCad .kicad_sch file. Every added component must include part_uuid. Recoverable item errors are returned (max 36). For circuit modification docs, read: /scratch/pkg/node_modules/kicad-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md

part_uuid.description: Component ID returned by component_search, get_schematic, or get_project_info.

signal_name.description: Signal reference: bare/global:<name>, local:<file-scope>:<name>, hier:<scope-or-sheet>:<port>. Optional typed prefixes: hier_input, hier_output, hier_bidirectional, hier_tri_state, hier_passive. Set port type on its defining sheet; a typed child-port reference must match its type. Plain hier preserves the existing type (new ports default to bidirectional). Copy references from get_schematic; foreign local scopes are errors. Empty means disconnected; NC is a no-connect marker; global:NC is a net.

search_query.description: A component search question. For example: "1k 1W smd resistor", "LM358", "2-pin power connector"

value.description: Minimum description: for simple components — only the nominal value; for microcircuits — only the name. Only ASCII symbols (e.g., "LM358", "10nF", "100k").

parameters_to_recalc.description: Parameters that will be recalculated to suit your needs

external_connect.description: Use only when you need to connect to a pin of an external component that you have not modified and that does not have a signal_name

external_rm_connect.description: Use only if you need to remove/break the connection from an external component's pin. Remember to remove external_rm_connect first and then add external_connect.

rm_components.description: Components to remove from the circuit

name: extract_circuit
title: Extract Circuit
